tier_label: Verification of the finished oil - cold flow and volatility
open_questions: API Group is not printed in any reviewed S-OIL document for Ultra-S 8; the Tier 1 API Group is Missing (2026-10 audit). S-OIL's published Ultra-S/aramcoULTRA equivalence and the Aramco catalog classification of aramcoULTRA 8 are indirect evidence only; see the Tier 1 open questions.
Chemistry is recorded from SDS DL2-15238.pdf, Section 3: Distillates (petroleum), hydrotreated heavy paraffinic; CAS 64742-54-7; revision date 2015-06-10.
Specific gravity at 15/4°C is dimensionless and must not be transcribed directly as absolute density.
No grade-specific MRV apparent viscosity, MRV yield stress, or MRV test temperature has been verified for Ultra-S 8.

CCS (6,300 mPa.s at -30 °C) and density (0.8425 kg/L at 15.6 °C) for Ultra-S 8 are recorded in Tier 1 from the current S-OIL Lube Base Oil web page, with that source stated; differences between that table and the archived sheets are listed as conflicts (2026-10 audit).
Final reconciliation between historical product data sheet DL2-11177.pdf, SDS DL2-15238.pdf, and current manufacturer product information remains pending.
